The scene features multiple musicians, including a guitarist in the foreground left and another musician center-right, illuminated by intense red and green stage lighting beams. The stage floor is reflective, showing strong red highlights. Several black stage monitors (speakers) are arranged along the front edge of the stage. In the background, there is a drum kit and other band members. The atmosphere is energetic with visible light rays cutting through haze.
